question: Will Chevron (CVX) Q3 oil-equivalent barrels per day net production (koebd) be above 4.1M?

source.title: Chevron 2026 2Q Earnings Conference Call Edited Transcript
source.access: official GCS quarterly earnings materials page identifies the transcript; browser-rendered official PDF read in full (16 pages). Direct local GET attempts are separately captured but yielded HTTPError with no numeric status in receipt.

facts: Prepared remarks: global upstream production grew >5% quarter-over-quarter; Q2 was the second-highest quarter, up >200 thousand BOE/day. U.S. production was a record nearly 2.1M BOE/day; international production nearly 2M. TCO and Australia were at/near full rates; reported Middle East conflict impact was isolated to Partitioned Zone (~1% of Q2 total). These are Q2 actual/operating context, not Q3 values.

TCO Q&A: management said its production waterfall was up 170 thousand BOE/day versus Q1 and each Q2 month was among TCO’s highest. A 2025 Q4 turnaround raised 3GP nameplate oil capacity 260→320 thousand b/d; total field processing capacity was slightly above 1M b/d. Capacity is not Chevron worldwide net BOE/day or a new Q3 increment.

CPC Q&A: two SPMs were in service; the third, then undergoing refurbishment, was expected to reopen during Q3, allowing all three later in Q3. Pipeline was flowing, with Caspian shipping, rail and storage as mitigations. This is a possible logistics relief, not a quantified production bridge.

Permian Q&A: >1M BOE/day for five quarters; management said it had continued to creep upward while the business focused on efficiency/productivity and a plateau. Management described highest surface reliability since 2024. No Q3 volume delta supplied.

Australia Q&A: interviewer raised typical Gorgon/Wheatstone LNG volume uplift in H2 starting Q3; CEO confirmed seasonality and said Australian assets were operating at high reliability. No volume/BOE figure or worldwide Q3 bridge supplied.

Transcript Q&A/prepared remarks provide no explicit Q3 worldwide net oil-equivalent total, no sequential Q2-to-Q3 amount, and no numerical Q3 Guyana net-entitlement change. Guyana is described as a long-lived growth asset only.
relation_to_other_primary_sources: Chevron’s later Aug7 sensitivity/forward-guidance PDF is separate: its 150–200 MBOED Q3 upstream turnarounds/downtime estimate does not appear as an explicit bridge in the July31 transcript. Do not add it to Q2 actual or infer an all-company Q3 result.
